recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove ServiceRequest from either the Clinical Module index or the Workflow hierarchy for FHIR-34376; any future move of the resource's module assignment should be based on a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-34376 asked to resolve the R4 inconsistency where ServiceRequest appeared under the Clinical module on the index and resource list but was missing from the Clinical module page, while the Workflow module also listed it. The issue was Published/Persuasive, non-substantive, and applied for R5.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-34376. The relevant source change was pre-applied by the R5 Clinical Summary Module QA work: commit a2cd585611 added ServiceRequest to the Clinical Module index, and commit 83fc604852 restored that listing after a temporary removal.
additional_context: OO minutes on 2023-03-20 record FHIR-34376 as pre-applied and published in R5, while noting that the Clinical module home page still listed ServiceRequest and ServiceRequest was assigned to Workflow. The March 2023 Module Ownership Zulip thread explains that a resource can have only one module breadcrumb, but other module pages can still comment on or list it. A later FHIR-44611 Workflow page change added guidance to consult domain-specific modules for resource relationships and did not reverse the accepted placement.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/clinicalsummary-module.html includes ServiceRequest in the Clinical Module index, while source/hierarchy.xml still assigns ServiceRequest under Workflow, matching the accepted distinction between module listing/commentary and the single breadcrumb assignment.

related_jiras.note: Patient Care's Clinical Summary Module QA added ServiceRequest and related resources to the Clinical Module index, providing the source application that satisfied FHIR-34376.
FHIR-I later clarified the Workflow module's relationship to domain modules; this supports the current interpretation and was already represented separately on the combined branch.
